messages:
hana_cs: Quick pulse on Seaworthy Labs renewal 1: their PO path stalled because vendor code not created; customer prefers CC but procurement flagged card auth for >$50k. SOW link: https://docsend.com/view/seaworthy-renewal-2026. Need final by Mon COB or we lose renewal month.

lee_se: Heads-up they asked for a 6-month term (pilot extension) and want invoice net30. They want two enablement sessions included in the term.

omar_ae: onboarding health: usage steady but feature flag for streaming not enabled. If renewal slips, retention risk goes up. Recommend lock schedule for enablement week of 4/5.

tara_proc: PO route requires W9 + remit address + legal name. If they insist CC, we need cardholder verification and a signed payment authorization form. Which do they prefer?

violet_legal: if they sign for 6mo, legal needs explicit clause about prorated termination credit and no automatic renewal. Draft snippet: "Term: 6 months. No automatic renewal; customer may renew by mutual written agreement." Anyone object?

hana_cs: i'll ask them today: confirm PO vs CC, confirm who will sign, share W9 if PO. Also ask whether they need KMS (they mentioned 'bring-your-own-key' briefly).

pricing-team: 6-month term -> need 12% uplift to list MRR to account for shorter commitment. If they add enablement and pay up front, we can reduce uplift to 6%. cc @hana_cs for offer wording.

pricing-team: also confirm seats and forecasted token consumption, we need to size Dedicated pool if they increase concurrency.

enablement: can do two 90-min sessions. prefer scheduling after contract executes. availability wk of 4/5 and 4/12.

tara_proc: if PO chosen, vendor-code expedite possible but vendor docs must hit inbox by EOD tomorrow. procurement@redwood.com. We can route new vendor code within 48h once docs validated.

hana_cs: customer replied: they want CC but will sign payment auth and provide cardholder name. signer will be thomas@seaworthy.com (VP Ops). W9 to follow. They asked if we can pro-rate add-on training into the 6mo price.

violet_legal: ok to add the no-auto-renew clause. also add: "All fees are non-refundable except as specified in Section X (prorate on termination)". Legal clears with this language.

pricing-team: propose this final: base price (6mo) = list * 1.12 minus 6% if paid upfront. training add-on billed on invoice as line item, prorated across 6mo. Confirm and we'll sign off.

hana_cs: i've created the DocuSign envelope for Seaworthy Renewal (SOW_2026_v3) 1 - signer: thomas@seaworthy.com. esign-bot will update when signed.

esign-bot: DocuSign envelope created: Seaworthy Renewal (SOW_2026_v3). Status: awaiting signature (thomas@seaworthy.com).

tara_proc: send W9 to procurement@redwood.com once you have it; if they provide W9 and remit address by EOD tomorrow, we'll push vendor code fast. If they stick to CC and payment auth, fraud team needs 24h for review.

hana_cs: TL;DR: Customer prefers CC + payment auth; W9 incoming. Pricing approved 12% uplift w/ 6% discount if upfront. Legal cleared. Onboarding reserved wk of 4/5 pending signature. Target: finalize by Mon COB. :rocket:
